summary: Iteration 17 — tested ONLY the 4 new tweaks (RAC payment method, Absences dialog + Kanban banner + Calendar red pills, co-visible technicians on project cards, editable commission rates). Backend: 17/17 pytest cases passed (/api/absences GET/POST/DELETE + validation + RBAC 403 for technicien + strict cross-tenant isolation, /api/settings commission_rates persistence/dedup/sort/range-filter + non-admin 403, RAC sale creation & persistence + dashboard/commissions regression). Frontend (public URL, admin + 2 technicien accounts): RAC option present & selectable in NewSaleSheet and EditSaleSheet, RAC sale created and displayed as 'RAC (Reste à charge)' in Ventes list; Absences button visible on Chantiers & Planning, dialog CRUD works end-to-end (create commercial absence + delete with confirm), red banner 'ABSENTS AUJOURD'HUI' lists absent people on Kanban (also visible for technicien role), Calendar shows red pills (cal-absence-{id}-{iso}) on every day of the range; adding '18%' rate in Commissions persists to /api/settings and propagates to Commissions summary/table and to NewSaleSheet commission dropdown (cache invalidated), delete removes it, and existing sale commission (10 %) was NOT recalculated; both co-assigned techniciens see BOTH badges (TEST_Tech_QA + TEST_Tech2_QA) on the same project card.

minor.issue: status is not validated against the allowed enum (a_planifier|en_cours|termine). Sending status='planifie' returns 200 and the chantier then disappears from ALL Kanban columns and is silently invisible to assigned techniciens. Add a Literal/enum validation in ProjectUpdate (found while seeding, reproducible).
No overlap/duplicate guard — the exact same person/date range can be inserted repeatedly, producing duplicate red pills/banner entries. Low impact, optional dedup.

integration_issues.issue: useCommissionRates uses a module-level 60s cache and only fetches on mount; a NewSaleSheet/EditSaleSheet already mounted in another open tab/route keeps the stale rate list until remount. Works correctly in the tested navigation flow (invalidateCommissionRatesCache is called after save), reported as a design note only.

issues: Radix console warning: Missing `Description` or `aria-describedby` for DialogContent (a11y, non-blocking)

Absence date inputs use native browser date pickers (type=date) instead of the shadcn calendar used elsewhere — consistent with the rest of the app's sheets, flagged only if design consistency with shadcn Calendar is desired

action_items: Validate project status against the allowed enum in PUT /api/projects/{id} (currently any string is accepted and hides the chantier from the Kanban)
Optional: add aria-describedby/DialogDescription to AbsencesDialog and the rates dialog to clear the Radix a11y warning
critical_code_review_comments: server.py ProjectUpdate.status should be typed as Literal['a_planifier','en_cours','termine'] — free-text status breaks Kanban/Calendar filtering.
AbsenceIn validation is solid (regex dates, person_type pattern, min_length name) and delete/list are tenant-scoped via cq(user) with {'_id': 0} projection — no ObjectId leak.
GET /api/settings normalises commission_rates (dedup + sort + 0..1 range) but PUT stores the raw list; consider normalising on write too so the stored document stays clean.

rca_of_the_issue: Only real defect found: PUT /api/projects/{id} accepts an arbitrary status string (ProjectUpdate.status is Optional[str]). Repro: PUT {status:'planifie'} → 200; the project then matches none of the Kanban columns (a_planifier/en_cours/termine) and shows nowhere for admin or assigned techniciens. Mitigation: constrain with Literal/enum and return 422 on invalid values.
